speedStep.label: Speed Step
speedStep.description: How much the Slower and Faster keys change the playback rate.

preferredSpeed.label: Preferred Speed
preferredSpeed.description: The speed the Preferred Speed key toggles to, and back from.

rewindSeconds.label: Rewind Seconds
rewindSeconds.description: How far the Rewind key jumps back.

advanceSeconds.label: Advance Seconds
advanceSeconds.description: How far the Advance key jumps forward.

rememberSpeed.label: Remember Speed
rememberSpeed.description: Start each new video at the last speed you set on that site. Off leaves every video at whatever speed the page itself chose.

enableAudio.label: Control Audio Too
enableAudio.description: Also put the controller on plain <audio> players, not just video.

position.label: Position
position.description: Which corner of the video the controller starts in. Drag it anywhere from there.

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.description: How solid the controller is, from 0 to 1.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Keep the controller out of sight until the Show/Hide key brings it back. The shortcuts still work.

applyInWebViews.label: Web View Notes
applyInWebViews.description: Control the videos on pages you browse inside Trilium Desktop's Web View note type.

applyInTrilium.label: Trilium's Own Players
applyInTrilium.description: Control video and audio notes, and the players Trilium embeds in text notes.

triliumShortcuts.label: Shortcut Scope In Trilium
triliumShortcuts.description: Trilium's tree and editor use bare letter keys too, so the shortcuts are normally limited to the player you are pointing at.

options.label: Only while the player is hovered or focused
Whenever a player is on screen

blacklist.label: Blocked Sites
blacklist.description: Sites the controller stays off. Matches subdomains too, so youtube.com also covers music.youtube.com.
